card.name: Aging and baby boomer workforce text
card.fires_on: Words inside passages about aging populations, older workers and demographic change, where "baby boomers" is likely to come next. It fires on linking words, commas, and numbers around age groups.

modes.label: Demographic change
modes.description: Words in sentences on workforce or population shifts, just before a generational term could appear.
modes.example: A demographic sea change is moving across the American workplace,<< as>> unprecedented in scope as it was unforeseen

modes.label: Older age groups
modes.description: Spaces, numbers or brackets around age cutoffs such as 50+ or age 40 and older.
modes.example: This page may be designed for the<< >>50+ crowd, but their information

modes.label: Aging population
modes.description: Words in sentences on a growing aging population needing care.
modes.example: as a substantial portion of our population<< is>> aging and requiring more medical care

card.writes: It pushes the word "baby" (as in baby boomers) and its Chinese equivalents as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up in text about aging generations and older workers, anticipating the phrase "baby boomers".
